# Provenance — `tpcds`

**Upstream:** https://www.tpc.org/tpcds/

**Knowledge record:** [`knowledge/datasets/tpc-ds.md`](../../knowledge/datasets/tpc-ds.md)

**Licence:** tpc-eula — see `LICENSE` beside this file.

## Source artifacts

**None downloaded.** This dataset is generated on the machine that builds it, so
there is no upstream file to pin and nothing of it is redistributed. What is pinned
is the *generator*: `docker/loader.Dockerfile` fixes the source commit it is built
from, and the loader records the commit it actually ran. The knowledge record for
this dataset states the cardinalities the specification requires, which is what the
tests assert instead of a content digest.

## What upstream publishes

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Official | `TPC-DS_Tools_v4.0.0.zip` via the registration/EULA form ([form](/sources/tpc-tools-download-request-form.md)); spec PDF v4.0.0 (2.9 MB) free but its text could not be extracted locally, so all clause citations are from **v2.10.0** shipped in tpcds-kit (`specification/TPC-DS_v2.10.0.pdf`, 3.4 MB). |
| Primary generator | DuckDB `tpcds` extension (dsdgen 2.10.0 port; `sf` DOUBLE so SF 0.01 works; `keys=true` adds PK/FK metadata) — [tool](/tools/duckdb-tpch-tpcds-extensions.md). |
| Cross-check + queries | https://github.com/gregrahn/tpcds-kit @ `5a3a81796992b725c2a8b216767e142609966752` (dsdgen/dsqgen 2.10.0; 99 templates; `answer_sets/`; `tools/tpcds.sql`, `tpcds_ri.sql`; `tests/mysql_setup.sh`) — [tool](/tools/tpcds-kit.md). Repo size 28,621 KB (API). |
| Checksums | none published; pins = commit SHA + DuckDB version; dsdgen is deterministic (`-RNGSEED` default 19620718). |

## Licence and attribution, as recorded

* [TPC EULA v2.2](/licenses/tpc-eula.md) for dsdgen/dsqgen/templates/`tpcds.sql` (all carry the TPC "Legal Notice"); nothing vendored; `datasets/tpcds/LICENSE` = EULA + legend. The 99 MySQL-ported queries are modified TPC Software: if committed they must ship under the EULA with the legend and unchanged TPC headers ([question](/questions/tpc-query-text-redistribution.md)); the default plan generates them at build time.
* Attribution string: "Derived from the TPC Benchmark™ DS Standard Specification (generator version 2.10.0; current specification v4.0.0), © Transaction Processing Performance Council. TPC Benchmark and TPC-DS are trademarks of the Transaction Processing Performance Council. This database and its query set are derived from TPC-DS and as such are not comparable to published TPC-DS results, as they do not comply with the TPC-DS Specification."

## Transformation

Converted by [`datasets/tpcds/convert.py`](convert.py). TPC-DS -> MySQL, generated rather than downloaded.

What was and was not ported:

None. (`tpcds_source.sql` staging tables and the data-maintenance views are not shipped.)

## Measured

24 tables, 19,557,579 rows. Per-table counts, digests, index sets,
query plans and canonical query results are pinned under `tests/` and are
checked on every build.
